diagnosis.hypothesis: Initial validation showed intermittent loss only on finance1<->app1 (66.7% packet loss) while other paths passed. I confirmed leaf2 is the shared gateway and that finance and server interfaces/routing were present, then tested a narrow MTU change on leaf2 ethernet-1/30 and ethernet-1/50; post-change validation worsened to 100% loss with net-unreachable symptoms for affected paths, so I rolled that change back successfully. Public success criteria did not pass and no safe repair was validated within the attempt.
diagnosis.reference: On finance1, egress traffic on interface eth1 toward app1 (10.10.50.10) has 30% of its packets corrupted by a traffic-control (netem) queueing discipline.
